## Commands (1)

- [/arc-council](../commands/arc-council.md) — Convene the arc council — deep research + independent adversarial debate + matched domain experts + verifier-graded synthesis → one decision, on any question (startup/business/finance/personal/politics/marketing/dev/design).

## Agents (12)

- [council-advocate](../agents/council-advocate.md) — Council member — builds the strongest evidence-based case FOR the decision under review. Convened for every arc-council run. Deliberately biased toward YES; kept honest by the Skeptic and Verifier.
- [council-designer](../agents/council-designer.md) — Council domain expert for design & UX questions — a user + craft lens (jobs-to-be-done, usability/friction, product-feel, accessibility, brand coherence). Convened by the Chair when the decision touches user experience, product design, or brand feel.
- [council-engineer](../agents/council-engineer.md) — Council domain expert for technical & product-build questions — a feasibility + engineering lens (complexity, effort, maintainability, build-vs-buy, technical risk). Convened by the Chair for architecture, tech-stack, and product-build decisions.
- [council-life-counselor](../agents/council-life-counselor.md) — Council domain expert for personal & life decisions — a values + wellbeing lens (reversibility, regret minimization, long-term wellbeing, what matters to the person). Convened by the Chair for career, relationship, and life-choice decisions.
- [council-marketer](../agents/council-marketer.md) — Council domain expert for marketing & growth questions — a positioning + demand lens (audience/ICP, channels & CAC, messaging, brand, retention). Convened by the Chair when the decision touches go-to-market, growth, or brand.
- [council-neutral](../agents/council-neutral.md) — Council member — takes NO side and weighs the decision dispassionately (base rates, tradeoffs, assumptions, unknowns). Convened for every arc-council run to keep the debate honest.
- [council-policy-analyst](../agents/council-policy-analyst.md) — Council domain expert for politics & policy questions — a stakeholder + systems lens (incentives, second- and third-order effects, precedent, feasibility, unintended consequences). Convened by the Chair for political/policy/societal decisions. Non-partisan.
- [council-researcher](../agents/council-researcher.md) — Council fact-finder — takes ONE sub-question, researches it (live web or model-knowledge), and returns a triangulated FACT PACK (facts + confidence + sources) for the Chair's shared Evidence Brief. Neutral: facts only, never a recommendation.
- [council-risk-analyst](../agents/council-risk-analyst.md) — Council domain expert for finance & investment questions — a risk/return lens (expected value, downside & ruin risk, diversification, liquidity, time horizon, taxes). Convened by the Chair for money decisions. Not licensed financial advice.
- [council-skeptic](../agents/council-skeptic.md) — Council member — builds the strongest evidence-based case AGAINST the decision under review. Convened for every arc-council run. Deliberately biased toward caution; kept honest by the Advocate and Verifier.
- [council-strategist](../agents/council-strategist.md) — Council domain expert for business & startup questions — a VC + operator lens (market, moat, GTM, unit economics, timing, competition, founder-fit). Convened by the Chair when the decision is about starting or growing a business.
- [council-verifier](../agents/council-verifier.md) — Council cross-examiner — grades the EVIDENCE behind each member's points (not the conclusions), rating every POINT-ID Supported / Plausible / Weak / Contested. Convened for every non-quick arc-council run to keep the debate honest.
